description: Construction of first floor side and rear extension and conversion of garage into a habitable room.
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:auto;mso-margin-bottom-alt:auto;
line-height:normal"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The proposed first-floor extension would be of a
poor appearance and design. It would appear as an excessively large and bulky
addition when viewed from the rear and would not appear subservient or
sympathetic to the host building. The proposals would be contrary to policies 53
of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024) and D1 and D4 of the London Plan (2021) and the </span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB">National Design Guide: Planning
practice guidance for beautiful, enduring and successful places (Jan 2021).<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:12.0pt;text-align:justify;line-height:
normal"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The proposed development would unduly impact on amenities of
the occupants of the neighbouring residential property no.30 Queenswood Avenue in
terms of being overbearing, causing a loss of sunlight, overshadowing, and a
significant reduction in outlook. Furthermore, it would unduly impact the
amenities of occupants at no.32 Queesnwood Avenue by creating a sense of enclosure,
being overbearing and causing harmful overshadowing. &nbsp;The development would be contrary to policy 57
of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>
